topic: Magento: overview and removing old Kelkoo tracking
queries: how do I set up sales tracking on Magento
I'm on Magento how do I set up tracking
remove old Kelkoo plugin from Magento
content:
This guide covers manually installing KST on Magento 1 or Magento 2 (up to 2.3). You will need to edit code to complete it.

Before starting:

- Get your merchantId and associated Country Code.
- Clean out any old version of Kelkoo Sales Tracking: search your code for **`leadtag.js`** and **`_kkstrack`** and remove any matches, then uninstall any Kelkoo Sales Tracking plugin from your website backend.
section_heading: Before setting up your Kelkoo Sales Tracking Tag

topic: Magento 1: install the Lead Tag via XML layout
queries: how do I set up sales tracking on Magento 1
I'm on Magento 1 how do I set up tracking
where does the leadtag go in Magento 1
content:
Magento needs both elements installed — the Leadtag (writes the cookie on first visit) and the Conversion tag (reads the cookie and registers the sale). **Both are mandatory for KST to work.**

For the Lead Tag, find and edit the right XML layout and add:

```
<reference name="head">
  <block type="core/text" name="kelkoo.lead.tag">
      <action method="setText">
        <text>
          <![CDATA[<script type="text/javascript" src="https://s.kk-resources.com/leadtag.js"></script>]]>
        </text>
      </action>
  </block>
</reference>
```

topic: Magento 2: install the Lead Tag without a module
queries: where does the lead tag script go in Magento 2
how do I set up sales tracking on Magento 2
I'm on Magento 2 how do I set up tracking
content:
To add the KST Lead Tag on Magento 2 without creating a module, add this to your active theme, in `YourTheme/Magento_Theme/layout/default_head_blocks.xml`:

```
<script src="https://s.kk-resources.com/leadtag.js" src_type="url"/>
```

1. If missing, create `app/code/` under your Magento installation. 2. Download the Magento 2 module: https://github.com/KelkooGroup/magento2-kelkoogroup-salestracking/archive/1.0.0.zip 3. Extract the zip contents into `/app/code`. 4. content:
Before setting up the tag on Shopify or Shopify Plus, get your merchantId and associated Country Code.

Kelkoo Group also publishes a video tutorial, "How to install KST for Shopify".

The Shopify installation uses **Customer Events (custom pixels)** — you create two pixels, one for the Lead Tag and one for the Conversion Tag.
